correctness.rationale: Perron characterization holds also at the path endpoint r=0. Explicit symmetric cosine/cosh positive eigenvectors solve the necessary boundary equation; the trigonometric and hyperbolic ratios are strictly monotone and have unique roots. The standalone script replayed 288 mixed exact polynomial, independent eigensystem and multiprecision scaling tests, as supporting finite evidence.

value.rationale: Single-edge weak perturbations of a cyclic shift are a natural operator model. Their critical 1/n window interpolates between fixed subcritical quadratic finite-size deficits and fixed supercritical exponentially small localization corrections; the two-sided sharp crossover is not implied by either individual expansion. The explicit limit function and monotone finite-size branches are substantive spectral boundary information beyond a textbook finite determinant evaluation.
